column3: ------ Hey! Wake up!

What a relief, you're okay! You were caught and thrown into this prison by the Magic Sergeant. You were unconscious when you got here. You're lucky you woke up just now. I've just finished the escape tunnel. Let's break out.
OK. Well, excuse me for going first. Your weapon and shield were stolen by the guards. It's not wise to wander about without them.

Ah, we meet again! Thank you for beating the Gate-Keeper of this area. I was defeated and imprisoned again. This prison is so small this time. I'm digging a secret tunnel in front of the Dragon. Go up to the 35th floor and wait for me while I finish it.
Don't worry, I'll be there.
Oh, thank you for your help. I will raise your offensive and defensive power by 3%. [You feel your strength rise.]
Hi, thank you for your help. Please accept a little reward. (Received 1000 Gold.)
Welcome to 'The Magic Tower'. You are the hundredth man who has dared to enter my tower. You will now face my guards. Should you survive, I will fight you in person. Accept your fate.
What? Oh!
I will grant you the Orb of the Hero. When you use it, you will see the strength of the monsters on the current floor and how much damage they can do to you. Make good use of it.
Ha ha ha! You are lucky to have gotten so far. Since it has come to this, I shall fight you personally, but first I must test your strength. Go and fight, Skeleton Soldiers!
You're better than I thought. But I will never let you pass. You will die here. Fight me!
No, it's not possible! You may have defeated me, but beyond this point you will meet enemies and traps more powerful than anything you've seen. If you are careless, you will die!
Hey! We meet again! You beat the boss of this area brilliantly. I was stuck, unable to go upstairs.
Ah! Are you all right? The Giant Octopus that lives here was blocking my way. But the tunnel is finally finished. You'd better put off fighting him. See you later!
Well, you found me. I will give you an elixir. Using this medicine, you will gain life according to your offensive and defensive power. It works best if you save it for later.
So, you beat the skeletons and broke in. Don't take me for small fry like a skeleton. I will show you that I am as immortal as a god. Hey, come on!
Good god! I never dreamed I'd be defeated. Your strength is beyond doubt. But as weak as you are, you will never defeat the Great Magic Master. Enjoy your fleeting victory while it lasts.
-K-I-L-L- -A-N- -I-N-V-A-D-E-R-
Now is the time. You were chosen. If you aren't afraid of death, go through the Gate of Time and Space, and come to me.
Oh! What? This is a doll!
The tunnel has not been completed yet. You should have waited a little longer, and you should not have used items. I had a bug in the program. There! Don't worry!
Oh, I have finished the tunnel. Wha? It's you again. You came at a good time. I have opened a tunnel, and you may use it freely.
The last boss and the captured princess must be in this area. Hmm, I wonder if we should wait before fighting him.
You are brave, beating the bosses of the first and second areas and climbing the tower. But the game is over now. Here and now, I will beat you myself! Give up!
You think you're pretty strong, huh? If you can make it to the 40th floor, I shall fight you again. There, you will die!
There you are. I have just finished the tunnel. Go through it and you'll reach the Dragon. Then go up.
The Golden Knight, the boss of this area, acts tough even though he is weak. That is why the Magic Sergeant, Zeno, the tower's second-in-command, dislikes him.
I wonder how you were able to come so far. I will make sure you go no further. I will humiliate you ten times worse than you have disgraced this tower. Ghost Soldiers, charge!
Humph, that was nothing! Soldiers, charge!
We're only getting started. Now the real fight begins. Swordsmen, charge!
Heck! How about this attack? Knights, charge!
How dare you defeat my followers? Never shall I forgive you! Now I won't hold back. Give up!
I'll let you go this time, though I don't like it. But next time we meet, we'll settle this for real. You'd better give up!
Oh! Sir Zeno. I was not able to catch the brave man. Please forgive me.

You weren't? I dare you to say that again. You come running up here like a coward and tell me you couldn't do your job. What a disgrace! This tower has no need for the likes of you! You've failed me for the last time. You shall now die.
Oh God, please forgive me! Ah!
Forgive that unseemly scene. But don't worry, I am quite different from such a fellow. If you make it up to me, I will fight you directly. I'll be waiting.
It's amazing that you found your way here at last. I compliment you. Now, as promised, I'll fight with you, man to man!
Alas...
Who? It's you! Why are you in such a place?
Humph. There is only one reason why I'm here. And this is it!
Huh? Hey! You're Zeno! Are you still alive?
I will never die. I merely tested your intelligence as a soldier.
Huh? What do you mean? Why did you do such a thing?

The Sacred Sword 'Weaponer', which you have, and the Omniscient Staff 'Intellion', which I have: legend says that whoever unites the two will receive great wisdom. But for that, the soldier who does so must be able to handle the power of that sword.
Are you saying... that I am that soldier?
Yes, you are correct. But when you came here, your ability wasn't sufficient to master the sacred sword 'Weaponer'.
Well, this means that the rumor that a princess was trapped here... was actually a lie to get me here, wasn't it?

Yes, that's right. And now, if we work together, this farce will end. Now is the time to act. With the power of omniscience, we shall break the sacred sword and receive great enlightenment. Soldier of the Sacred Sword! Let's finish this!
I believe there is a sword on the 5th floor and a shield on the 9th. You had better get them first. See you later!
I heard that there is a shield on the 11th floor and a sword on the 17th. I'd get them if I were you. Excuse me for going first!
For that reason, I gave false information, set various traps in this tower, and waited for you to come. And, just as planned, you came here having mastered enough power to wield the sacred sword.
I have nothing to say. A certain message may be hidden in this room.
You villain. Little did I expect to be beaten. But I would never die in such a way. I'll be looking forward to fighting with you again.
There are doors which cannot be opened with a key. These doors only open when you beat the monsters guarding them.
If you buy goods from merchants, you will be able to hear important information later.
This magic tower has 50 floors, and every ten floors form one area. Each area is controlled by a boss, and until you beat it, you cannot go any higher.
When you offer gold at an altar, it is often better to raise your defense rather than your attack. But if you never raise your attack, you may meet an enemy you cannot beat.
Did you notice the secret passages on the 9th, 16th, and 18th floors?
If you carry a cross, the strength of Zombies and Vampires will be cut in half. It is nearly impossible to defeat them without a cross, especially Vampires. There is a cross on a higher floor.
I heard that you can find a red key in two places in this area.
In this area, if you don't raise your offensive power at an altar a few times, you may not be able to destroy 'Rock' monsters. Be careful!

The Great Magic Master is in this area. He is the master of this magic tower. At your strength, attacking him means death. It stands to reason that you should not face him, but rather get items on higher floors first.
At this point, if your vital power is 1500, offensive power 80 and defensive power 98, and you have five yellow keys and one blue key, you are in nearly ideal shape.

The offensive power of the swordsman who uses two swords is too high. He can use two swords at the same time. You will lose much strength if you fight him normally. You should never fight him until your attack is stronger than his.
This tower is 50 stories high, but in reality it seems that you cannot go up to the 50th floor.
More haste, less speed.
You may be able to go upstairs without fighting strong enemies, if you make clever use of the four tunnels on this floor.
You need the mattock in order to get the treasure which is in the item warehouse on this floor.
There is never a gate without a Gate-Keeper. Conversely there are always enemies who keep the gate on floors that have gates. So...
At three o'clock, the secret treasure that lets one travel in space will appear.
There is a Lucky Gold somewhere in this tower. If you have it, you can get twice as much money when you beat an enemy.

A Magician will attack using magic when he is next to you. If you step between two Magic Sergeants, they will halve your vital power with magic. When they attack from both sides, the stronger you are, the more damage you take. So be careful.
The 44th floor in this tower is an illusion. It seems you can't get there by the stairs. I think the only way is to teleport.
The sacred shield can defend you against magic attacks. But I heard this shield is hidden on a floor that doesn't exist.
The 41st floor is perfectly symmetrical, and therefore...
If you want to beat the Dragon, you must have a holy sword, a holy shield, and the Dragon Slayer, and you must also be strong.
It is said that the symbol of 5 on a pair of dice has the force of sealing magic. You had better memorize it until you fight the boss of this area.
I have done what I can. Good luck!
Oh, thank you for your help. I will raise your offensive and defensive power by 3 percent as a token of my gratitude. [You begin to feel stronger.]
I will grant you the Orb of the Hero. You will now be able to save your game, and to forecast the results of fighting monsters on the current floor. Use it often.

Thank goodness, you found me. I will give you an elixir as a symbol of my gratitude. Using this medicine will cause you to gain life according to your offensive and defensive power. So naturally, the later you use it, the stronger its effect.
Be careful. I have nothing more to say.
Please use it wisely.
You have perished in the Sorcerer's Tower. Please try again!
